raw_once_v4.raw_decode: Decode exactly 2000 unique validation logical event objects once, in checkpoint/selection UID order, before evaluator subprocesses; never reopen raw sources after the materialization receipt fsync.
raw_once_v4.teacher_batches: For ordinals 0..499, collate four consecutive decoded events once then normalize_batch once; exactly 500 immutable batch-size-four bundles.
raw_once_v4.rollout_singletons: For ordinals 0..999, separately collate and normalize a singleton; never slice teacher tensors as rollout input.
raw_once_v4.immutable_consumption: Payloads full-write/fsync/parent-fsync/chmod read-only/rehashed; evaluators open only immutable bundles and no raw source, collate or normalizer.

tensor_serialization_v4.rules: phase teacher|rollout; contiguous ordinals; tensor keys UTF-8 byte sorted; dtype ASCII str(torch.dtype); shape nonnegative integer array; detached contiguous CPU logical bytes in little-endian runtime; byte_length exact; SHA-256 payload; one record per tensor key per phase/ordinal.

manifest_schema_v4.immutability: All payload files are fsynced, parent-fsynced, chmod read-only and rehashed before block one; manifests bind raw access, UID/event/tensor/batch/normalizer/target-level/boundary hashes.

teacher_forward_plan_v4.target_level_list: Per normalized teacher batch, sorted unique integer level_ids>0 under node_mask; nonempty and persisted.
teacher_forward_plan_v4.identity: Exactly one forward per ordered (batch ordinal, positive target level), batch 0..499 then ascending level; no duplicate, omitted, singleton, reordered or diagnostic forward.
teacher_forward_plan_v4.total: Sum target-level-list lengths and SHA-256 canonical ordered pairs in materialization, plan, every block and final receipt.
teacher_forward_plan_v4.per_event: Slice produced output/matches/confidence targets/normalized tensors for event indices 0..3; no second forward, recollation, renormalization or singleton teacher evaluation.
teacher_forward_plan_v4.batch_boundary: Use v3 uint64-be ordinal/count and length-prefixed UID bytes over 500 four-UID batches.

numeric_contributions_v4.sigmoid: torch.sigmoid once on original device and frozen logits dtype; no pre-cast.
numeric_contributions_v4.comparison: ECE bin comparisons and confidence subtraction/square on original device/dtypes with [i/10,(i+1)/10), final upper inclusive.
numeric_contributions_v4.brier: After frozen-dtype square, logical C-order event slice scalars cast individually to binary64, math.fsum and exact count.
numeric_contributions_v4.ece: Per event/bin, logical C-order selected probability/target scalars cast to binary64; exact count and math.fsum probability/target sums.
numeric_contributions_v4.loss: Frozen sliced-event loss from already-produced tensors per positive level; cast scalar after computation; math.fsum ascending levels and exact count.
numeric_contributions_v4.bootstrap_serialization: Repeat stored binary64 UID contributions; math.fsum matrix-column order; exact integer counts; divide once; finite canonical allow_nan=false JSON, no -0.0.

structural_inequalities_v4.record_types: event_uid nonempty string; event_index exact 0..999; source_role validation; fallback false; indicators booleans; counts nonnegative JSON integers; source_jaccard_sum finite binary64.

structural_inequalities_v4.hard: Every UID tree_valid, reconstruction_valid, scheduled_rollout_valid and full leaf retention; recursive conflicts zero; teacher and predicted P4 closure exact; fallback zero.

No interpreter, model, allocation, module cache or tensor survives from another block.
v4_detail_nodes.warmup_v4: Teacher signature is exact target_level_list; choose lowest batch ordinal per distinct signature, selected ordinals ascending, exactly one forward per level. Rollout signature space is conservatively bound by 9 truth depths × 3 multiplicity buckets × 4 modes × 8 levels; select lowest ordinal for each observed signature and execute exact frozen teacher/predicted/bounded/scheduled controls. Bind selected ordinals, signatures and digest before block one; identical across all blocks.
v4_detail_nodes.between_blocks_v4: Parent waits for clean subprocess exit, verifies durable block receipt, zero surviving child/GPU process and all before/after invariants, then starts the next fresh subprocess; no page-touch refresh or scientific read.
fresh_subprocess_lifecycle_v4: synchronize and reset CUDA peak stats
measure exact 500 batch4 and 1000 singleton plan

After each block and after final exit, verify checkpoint/model/input/content/inode/owner/mode/link-count/canonical-path hashes and stats unchanged; any drift blocks.
